strongest_attack: Theorem clause (5) is load-bearing false: monomorphism Z->M_{6,6} only yields Z ≅ im(Z), not that the (6,6) CE evaluation-failure locus equals balanced Z. CE failure is relative to a cover. On the unbalanced Maroni stratum F=O(3)(+)O(6) the SRC-0004 obstruction degrees are 4f+n-2g-14 = -8 (f=3) and +4 (f=6); the f=6 summand is a positive-degree Brill-Noether condition whose failure points still forget to M_{6,6} outside im(Z). Secondary residual tension: theorem (4) asserts Z is canonically the smooth S_6-torsor/AJ model while (6) and FND-0046 keep Fitting/determinantal equality open under excess 2. Outcome: attempt refuted as a theorem statement; several geometric lemmas on H^bal (adjunction, Lemmas A/B, h^0 constancy, P^red) survive as partial progress toward C66-GEO-Z.
theorem_statement: Let k be a field of characteristic 0. Let H be the algebraic stack over k of pairs (C, gamma) with C smooth projective geometrically connected of genus 6 and gamma : C -> P^1 finite flat of degree 4, taken modulo automorphisms of the target; H is a smooth DM stack of dimension 15. Let H^bal be the open substack on which the Casnati-Ekedahl rank-2 bundle F on the relative P^1 has balanced splitting type F = O(4) (+) O(5) (degrees taken relative to the universal P^1-bundle), and let pi : Cu -> H^bal be the universal curve, D := gamma^* O_{P^1}(1) the universal g^1_4 divisor class of relative degree 4, W_5 the f_2 = 5 constituent of (O_{P(E)}(2) tensor gamma^* F^vee)|_Cu of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6, and L := W_5 tensor omega_{Cu/H^bal}^{-1}, of relative degree 6. Let Conf := Conf_6(Cu/H^bal) be the stack of ordered 6-tuples of pairwise distinct sections with universal divisor Du, and let Z subset Conf be the locus at which the Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation map of SRC-0004 Lemma 10.6 fails, i.e. H^0(C, omega_C tensor W|_C^vee(Gamma)) =/= 0 with Gamma = x_1 + ... + x_6. Then, with all line bundles on Cu understood up to twist by a line bundle pulled back from H^bal (which affects no statement below): (1) O_{P(E)}(1)|_Cu = omega_{Cu/P^1}, hence W_5 = omega_{Cu/H^bal}^{2}(-D) and L = omega_{Cu/H^bal}(-D); the f = 4 constituent contributes nothing and the evaluation map fails at Gamma if and only if Gamma + D is a canonical divisor on C, equivalently O_C(Gamma) = L; (2) every curve C carried by H^bal is non-hyperelliptic and satisfies h^0(O_C(D)) = 2, hence h^0(L) = 3 identically on H^bal; (3) pi_* L is locally free of rank 3 and its formation commutes with base change, so P := P(pi_* L) -> H^bal is a P^2-bundle canonically identified with the relative complete linear system |L|, and its reduced-support open P^red subset P is nonempty and dense in every geometric fibre of P -> H^bal; (4) Z is canonically the total space of the finite etale S_6-torsor Conf x_{|L|} P^red -> P^red; consequently Z -> H^bal is smooth and surjective of relative dimension 2, Z is smooth of pure dimension 17, and every irreducible component of Z dominates an irreducible component of H^bal; (5) the forgetful morphism Z -> M_{6,6} is a monomorphism of stacks, so the (6,6) Casnati-Ekedahl evaluation-failure locus in M_{6,6} is isomorphic to Z and is a constructible substack of pure dimension 17, i.e. of pure codimension 4; and (6) Z has codimension 4 in Conf whereas the generic determinantal expectation for the failure condition is 6, so the failure degeneracy locus carries excess 2, and no assertion is made here about its Fitting/determinantal scheme structure, about closedness of its image in M_{6,6}, or about the Hodge-Tate type of its cohomology.
